ios.desc: This app combines expense tracking app, and bill splitting into one unified app for seamless expense tracking

show_hn.title: Show HN: An app that tracks expenses by splitting bills

quotes.text:
Living with college friends, 99% of my transactions are split amongst people, and as such me and my friends use bill splitting apps a lot. A problem with this is that this has made it very difficult for me to track my expenses. Since different payments are made by different people , part of those would be my expenses

So I thought if my bill splitting app itself also tracked my expenses, if everyone simply used this app to split their payments, each members expenses would get tracked automatically. And this led me to create TrueCents

I'd been working on it for a few months but until now its just been me and a few friends on the app. Now I'd like to get more people to try and use the app, hence this post.

Co-incidentally recently splitwise has become very restrictive in its free tier, which makes me think this can be even more useful.

The app is made using flutter and firebase currently, but I do plan to switch from firebase if there's significant interest in the product

Looking forward to your feedback and suggestions
